outline: This course mainly introduces the latest AI technologies and applications, as well as how to use mainstream deep learning frameworks: TensorFlow & PyTorch. Students taking this course must possess good programming skills. Meanwhile, we will also introduce some fundamental AI algorithms.
schedule:
1.	Brief history of AI
2.	Machine Learning: How to make machine learn?
3.	Linear Algebra and Probability
4.	Gradient and Optimization
5.	Supervised Learning: Classification
6.     Supervised Learning: Regression
7.	Unsupervised Learning: Clustering
8.     Unsupervised Learning: Dimension Reduction
9.	Midterm exam
10.   Deep Learning and Neural Networks
11.	Natural Language Processing (NLP), RNN, LSTM
12.	Transformer, ChatGPT, LLMs
13.	Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
14.	Object Detection and Image Segmentation
15.	GAN & Diffusion
16.	Deep Reinforcement Learning
17.	Final project demo
18.	Final exam
assessment:
Kaggle homeworks (40%)
Midter and final exam (30%)
Final project (20%)
Quizzes and attendance (10%)
